text_en: King Antiochus was going through the upper provinces when he heard that Elymais in Persia was a city famed for its wealth in silver and gold.
text_cn: 安提约古王出巡高原时，听说在波斯有一座城，名叫厄里买，以富有金银著名；

text_en: Its temple was very rich, containing golden shields, breastplates, and weapons left there by Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian king who first reigned over the Greeks.
text_cn: 城中的庙宇很富，并且还有金盾铠甲和武器，都是马其顿王斐理伯之子希腊首任国王亚历山大遗留下的。

text_en: So he came and tried to take the city and plunder it, but he could not because his plan had become known to the citizens
text_cn: 他便来到那里，想攻占那城，但没有成功，因为城里的人早已知道他的来意，

text_en: and they withstood him in battle. So he fled and in great disappointment left there to return to Babylon.
text_cn: 竟起来与他交战，他临阵逃走，狼狈地离开那里，回到巴比伦。

text_en: Then someone came to him in Persia and reported that the armies that had gone into the land of Judah had been routed;
text_cn: 有人来到波斯给他报告说：“那开往犹太地的军队已经败退；

text_en: that Lysias had gone first with a strong force, but had turned and fled before the Jews; that the Jews had grown strong from the arms, supplies, and abundant spoils that they had taken from the armies they had cut down;
text_cn: 带劲旅去前线的里息雅，一见犹太人就退却了；犹太人却夺得败军的兵器及大批物资，力量大增。

text_en: that they had torn down the abomination that he had erected on the altar in Jerusalem; and that they had surrounded the sanctuary with high walls as before, and also Beth-zur, his town.
text_cn: 他们又拆毁王在耶路撒冷的祭坛上建立的可憎之物，将圣所及贝特族尔王寨用高墙围起来，恢复了旧观。”

text_en: When the king heard this news, he was astounded and badly shaken. He took to his bed and became sick from disappointment, because things had not turned out for him as he had planned.
text_cn: 王听了这些话，惊慌失措，倒在床上，忧郁成疾，因为事情没有符合他的理想。

text_en: He lay there for many days, because deep disappointment continually gripped him, and he realized that he was dying.
text_cn: 在那里一连多日，忧郁日渐加重，知道死期近了，

text_en: So he called all his Friends and said to them, “Sleep has departed from my eyes and I am downhearted with worry.
text_cn: 便将他的诸位朋友叫来，对他们说：“睡眠离开了我眼睛，愁思齐集在我的心头。

text_en: I said to myself, ‘To what distress I have come! And into what a great flood I now am plunged! For I was kind and beloved in my power. ’
text_cn: 我心里想，从前我得势的时候，多么高兴，多么受人爱戴；如今遭受的是什么灾难，遇到的是什么巨浪啊！

text_en: But now I remember the wrong I did in Jerusalem. I seized all its vessels of silver and gold, and I sent to destroy the inhabitants of Judah without good reason.
text_cn: 现在回想起我在耶路撒冷所作的恶事：我掠去城中的一切金器银器，无缘无故遣人去消灭犹太的居民。

text_en: I know that it is because of this that these misfortunes have come upon me; here I am, perishing of bitter disappointment in a strange land. ”
text_cn: 如今我明白了，我遭遇这些凶祸，正是为了这个缘故，看，我将在异乡忧郁而死！”

text_en: Then he called for Philip, one of his Friends, and made him ruler over all his kingdom.
text_cn: 他将自己的一个朋友斐理伯叫来，立他为全国的元首；

text_en: He gave him the crown and his robe and the signet, so that he might guide his son Antiochus and bring him up to be king.
text_cn: 然后将自己的冠冕、长袍和权戒交给他，叫他辅导自己的儿子安提约古，抚养他继承王位。

text_en: Thus King Antiochus died there in the one hundred forty-ninth year.
text_cn: 安提约古王就死在那里，时在一百四十九年。

text_en: When Lysias learned that the king was dead, he set up Antiochus the king’s son to reign. Lysias had brought him up from boyhood; he named him Eupator.
text_cn: 里息雅知道王已去世，遂立太子安提约古为王， 因为他自幼抚养过他，就给他起名叫欧帕托尔。

text_en: Meanwhile the garrison in the citadel kept hemming Israel in around the sanctuary. They were trying in every way to harm them and strengthen the Gentiles.
text_cn: 那时，那些住在堡垒里的人，常包围圣所，困扰以色列人，不断加害百姓，而支持异民。

text_en: Judas therefore resolved to destroy them, and assembled all the people to besiege them.
text_cn: 犹大决意铲除他们，便召集全体百姓，向他们围攻。

text_en: They gathered together and besieged the citadel in the one hundred fiftieth year; and he built siege towers and other engines of war.
text_cn: 一百五十年，以色列人齐来围攻堡垒，同时还造了战楼与军械。

text_en: But some of the garrison escaped from the siege and some of the ungodly Israelites joined them.
text_cn: 被包围的人中，有几个突围而出，与一些以色列浪人勾结，

text_en: They went to the king and said, “How long will you fail to do justice and to avenge our kindred?
text_cn: 去见王说：“你何时才实行正义，为我们的弟兄伸冤呢？

text_en: We were happy to serve your father, to live by what he said, and to follow his commands.
text_cn: 我们很愿意服事你的父亲，遵行他的话，顺从他的命令，

text_en: For this reason the sons of our people besieged the citadel and became hostile to us; moreover, they have put to death as many of us as they have caught, and they have seized our inheritances.
text_cn: 为这个缘故，我们的百姓才包围堡垒，仇视我们，遇见我们一个，便杀一个，还夺去了我们的产业。

text_en: It is not against us alone that they have stretched out their hands; they have also attacked all the lands on their borders.
text_cn: 他们不但伸手加害我们，而且还加害你的一切领域。

text_en: And see, today they have encamped against the citadel in Jerusalem to take it; they have fortified both the sanctuary and Beth-zur;
text_cn: 他们今天正扎营围困耶路撒冷的堡垒，想要占据；且防守圣所及贝特族尔。

text_en: unless you quickly prevent them, they will do still greater things, and you will not be able to stop them. ”
text_cn: 若不及早加以防范，必为后患，那你就不能制服他们了。”

text_en: The king was enraged when he heard this. He assembled all his Friends, the commanders of his forces and those in authority.
text_cn: 王听罢大怒，立即召集诸位朋友、军官和骑兵将领，

text_en: Mercenary forces also came to him from other kingdoms and from islands of the seas.
text_cn: 也把从外国及海岛招募来的军队，召到他前。

text_en: The number of his forces was one hundred thousand foot soldiers, twenty thousand horsemen, and thirty-two elephants accustomed to war.
text_cn: 军队的数目：共计步兵十万，骑兵两万，受过军训的象三十二头。

text_en: They came through Idumea and encamped against Beth-zur, and for many days they fought and built engines of war; but the Jews sallied out and burned these with fire, and fought courageously.
text_cn: 他们由依杜默雅抵达后，便扎营围困贝特族尔，攻打了多日，同时也造了军械；但犹太人冲出来，用火烧了那些军械，都奋勇作战。

text_en: Then Judas marched away from the citadel and encamped at Beth-zechariah, opposite the camp of the king.
text_cn: 那时犹大撤离堡垒，移营到贝特匝加黎雅，与王营对峙。

text_en: Early in the morning the king set out and took his army by a forced march along the road to Beth-zechariah, and his troops made ready for battle and sounded their trumpets.
text_cn: 王清晨起来，即移营向贝特匝加黎雅进军，军队列队上阵，响起号角。

text_en: They offered the elephants the juice of grapes and mulberries, to arouse them for battle.
text_cn: 有人在象前，放上葡萄汁和桑葚汁，引诱它们上阵作战，

text_en: They distributed the animals among the phalanxes; with each elephant they stationed a thousand men armed with coats of mail, and with brass helmets on their heads; and five hundred picked horsemen were assigned to each beast.
text_cn: 把象分编成队，每只象旁站一千人，都身披铠甲，头戴钢盔；又为每只象派有精骑五百。

text_en: These took their position beforehand wherever the animal was; wherever it went, they went with it, and they never left it.
text_cn: 这些骑兵从前常同这兽在一起，兽往哪里去，他们也随着去，总不离开。

text_en: On the elephants were wooden towers, strong and covered; they were fastened on each animal by special harness, and on each were four armed men who fought from there, and also its Indian driver.
text_cn: 在每只兽身上，系着一座掩护坚固的木楼，里面有四个作战勇士，此外还有一个驾驭象的印度人。

text_en: The rest of the cavalry were stationed on either side, on the two flanks of the army, to harass the enemy while being themselves protected by the phalanxes.
text_cn: 又将其余马队，分为军中左右两翼，为惊扰对方，也为掩护阵线。

text_en: When the sun shone on the shields of gold and brass, the hills were ablaze with them and gleamed like flaming torches.
text_cn: 太阳照在金牌铜牌上，光耀反射在山上，闪烁有如火炬。

text_en: Now a part of the king’s army was spread out on the high hills, and some troops were on the plain, and they advanced steadily and in good order.
text_cn: 王的军队一部分在高山上，一部分在平原里，一起稳步前进。

text_en: All who heard the noise made by their multitude, by the marching of the multitude and the clanking of their arms, trembled, for the army was very large and strong.
text_cn: 众人的喧哗声，进军的步伐声，军器的摩擦声，凡听了无不战栗，因为王的军队实在强大。

text_en: But Judas and his army advanced to the battle, and six hundred of the king’s army fell.
text_cn: 犹大和他的军队一临阵，王的军队便阵亡了六百人。

text_en: Now Eleazar, called Avaran, saw that one of the animals was equipped with royal armor. It was taller than all the others, and he supposed that the king was on it.
text_cn: 号称奥郎的厄肋阿匝尔， 见一只兽披着王甲，比众兽都高，便以为在上面的是王，

text_en: So he gave his life to save his people and to win for himself an everlasting name.
text_cn: 为了拯救百姓，为自己永远成名，他就决意牺牲自己。

text_en: He courageously ran into the midst of the phalanx to reach it; he killed men right and left, and they parted before him on both sides.
text_cn: 于是勇往直前，冲入阵中，左右乱杀，敌军居然被他随处冲散；

text_en: He got under the elephant, stabbed it from beneath, and killed it; but it fell to the ground upon him and he died.
text_cn: 他跑到象下，伏身将它刺杀了，象跌倒在地，压在他身上，他就死在那里。

text_en: When the Jews saw the royal might and the fierce attack of the forces, they turned away in flight.
text_cn: 犹太人见王的军力强盛，军队攻击得又凶猛，就从他们前退却了。

text_en: The soldiers of the king’s army went up to Jerusalem against them, and the king encamped in Judea and at Mount Zion.
text_cn: 王的军队直开往耶路撒冷，攻打他们，王便面对犹太和熙雍山安营。

text_en: He made peace with the people of Beth-zur, and they evacuated the town because they had no provisions there to withstand a siege, since it was a sabbatical year for the land.
text_cn: 王与贝特族尔人讲了和，他们就出了城，是因为城被包围已没有存粮，又因为那一年正是田地的安息年。

text_en: So the king took Beth-zur and stationed a guard there to hold it.
text_cn: 王便占据了贝特族尔，在那里派军队把守。

text_en: Then he encamped before the sanctuary for many days. He set up siege towers, engines of war to throw fire and stones, machines to shoot arrows, and catapults.
text_cn: 王在圣所对面安营多日，且在那里建立了战楼，制造军械，火箭机，抛石机和蝎子机，为发箭抛石。

text_en: The Jews also made engines of war to match theirs, and fought for many days.
text_cn: 犹太人为抵抗敌人武器，自己也制造了利器，双方酣（hān）战多日。

text_en: But they had no food in storage, because it was the seventh year; those who had found safety in Judea from the Gentiles had consumed the last of the stores.
text_cn: 只是仓中没有粮食，因为这年正是安息年，又因为从外方被救回犹太地的人民，将存粮都吃光了，

text_en: Only a few men were left in the sanctuary; the rest scattered to their own homes, for the famine proved too much for them.
text_cn: 所以在圣所里只留下少数人，因为饥饿逼人，各自四散回本乡去了。

text_en: Then Lysias heard that Philip, whom King Antiochus while still living had appointed to bring up his son Antiochus to be king,
text_cn: 里息雅听说：当先王还活着的时候，派定抚养自己的儿子安提约古，并辅佐他为王的斐理伯，

text_en: had returned from Persia and Media with the forces that had gone with the king, and that he was trying to seize control of the government.
text_cn: 和与王一起出征的军队，从波斯及玛待回来，企图夺取政权。

text_en: So he quickly gave orders to withdraw, and said to the king, to the commanders of the forces, and to the troops, “Daily we grow weaker, our food supply is scant, the place against which we are fighting is strong, and the affairs of the kingdom press urgently on us.
text_cn: 里息雅一听说，就决意急速撤兵，便向王与军官及众人说：“我们一天比一天衰弱，又缺少食粮，围困的地方又牢不可破，况且国家的大事都压在我们身上，

text_en: Now then let us come to terms with these people, and make peace with them and with all their nation.
text_cn: 所以现在，我们不如先同这些人携手，与他们及他们的百姓讲和，

text_en: Let us agree to let them live by their laws as they did before; for it was on account of their laws that we abolished that they became angry and did all these things. ”
text_cn: 使他们按自己的法律生活，如同先前一样，因为他们正是为了我们废弃他们法律的缘故，才大发盛怒，作出这一切事。”

text_en: The speech pleased the king and the commanders, and he sent to the Jews an offer of peace, and they accepted it.
text_cn: 王和各将领都满意这话，便打发使者到犹太人那里去讲和，犹太人也予以接受。

text_en: So the king and the commanders gave them their oath. On these conditions the Jews evacuated the stronghold.
text_cn: 王和各将领也对他们发了誓，因此，他们才从堡垒里出来。

text_en: But when the king entered Mount Zion and saw what a strong fortress the place was, he broke the oath he had sworn and gave orders to tear down the wall all around.
text_cn: 可是，当王到了熙雍山，见了这地方的堡垒，便立时背弃誓约，命人将四周的围墙拆毁。

text_en: Then he set off in haste and returned to Antioch. He found Philip in control of the city, but he fought against him, and took the city by force.
text_cn: 然后，急速起程，回到安提约基雅，见斐理伯已在城内掌权，就与他作战，用武力将城夺回。
